title: WorldPop Population & Demographic Structure — Assam Revenue Circles (Annual)
description: Annual population count, sex ratio, and age-structure statistics per Revenue Circle in Assam, derived from WorldPop 100m gridded population and age-sex structure rasters, used as an exposure input to the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Exposure covariate (population at risk) for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: 2016-2020 values are sourced directly from WorldPop; 2021 onward are extrapolated using linear regression on the 2015-2020 growth rate (see Sources/WORLDPOP/scripts/projections.py) and are therefore modelled, not observed, estimates. Per the risk model's data dictionary, sum_population is 'Exposure' category there while mean_sex_ratio/sum_aged_population/sum_young_population are 'Vulnerability' category — IDS-DRR's own composite-risk-index taxonomy differs from RDLS's hazard/exposure/vulnerability/loss object types, and all four are still catalogued here as RDLS 'exposure' (population counts/ratios describing who is in the hazard-prone area), which is the correct RDLS type regardless of IDS-DRR's internal pillar labelling. The dictionary also lists a fifth indicator, total-female-population (Vulnerability, CC BY 4.0, currently used_for_model=n), which has no corresponding file anywhere under Sources/master in this repo — it does not appear to be implemented yet, so it is not represented here.

gazetteer_entries.description: Assam Revenue Circles administrative boundaries (the object_id used across IDS-DRR variables) — a custom scheme, not yet a registered RDLS gazetteer.
